A DIFFERENT KIND OF BRIGHT

Outside is
where we reset.

OUR POINT OF VIEW

Less noise.
More night sky.

Northline started with a simple thought: the best gear doesn’t ask for attention. It just helps you stay a little longer.

We’re a small team of designers and outdoor enthusiasts who believe time outside is time well spent. We create dependable lighting that feels intuitive to use and is thoughtfully made for the moments that matter: cooking after sunset, finding your way back to the tent, and sharing one more story before sleep.

Our work begins with listening: to people who use their gear, to the places they take it, and to the details that make an ordinary evening feel like something more.

“Good design gives you one less thing to think about,
so you can focus on being there.”

THE NORTHLINE WAY

A THOUGHTFUL TOOL FOR AFTER DARK

One lantern.
A hundred little moments.

Fieldlight 360 brings warm, adjustable light to your campsite, cabin, or backyard. Its 3600mAh rechargeable battery powers your evening and can share a little energy with your USB-powered essentials when you need it.

MADE FOR THE IN-BETWEEN HOURS

THE DETAILS THAT MATTER

USB-C charging
